tools.name: mugshot_portrait
tools.description: Fetch one bot portrait as SVG for a roll name and index (0-99). Returns SVG text, request URL, and optional save_to path.

name.description: Roll name (A-Z0-9, max 12, normalized). Alias: roll.

animate.description: Opt-in SMIL animation (sets animate=1; response may include X-Mugshot-Animate)

save_to.description: Optional relative path under PLUGIN_DATA to write the SVG file

tools.name: mugshot_lineup
tools.description: List all 100 bots for a roll name (compact fields) plus the lineup.svg URL for the same render options.

tools.name: mugshot_rap_sheet
tools.description: Return one bot from the lineup JSON: nickname, role, booking, rapSheet, traits summary, and portrait URL.
